scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @socialverse/client" "npm run dev -w @socialverse/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @socialverse/shared && npm run build -w @socialverse/server && npm run build -w @socialverse/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @socialverse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @socialverse/server && npm run typecheck -w @socialverse/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @socialverse/server && npm run test -w @socialverse/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @socialverse/server && npm run lint -w @socialverse/client
